# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 61 (Bu-Vb Pc61)

**ID:** Bu-Vb Pc61  
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)  
**Collection:** Vinaya  
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 61  
**Title (English, from literature):** Intentionally killing a living being  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul0.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul0.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 In some non-Pali versions of the rule, the term *pāṇa* is explicitly glossed as animals (*tiryagyonigata*) [Schmithausen 1991b]. An English translation has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
